Cyclist Magazine Podcast: Matt Stephens, on Pogačar’s crash, women’s Monuments and transfer talk

This week on the Cyclist Magazine Podcast Robyn is joined by cycling’s most lovable, excitable and expert-able ex-pro, commentator, pundit and interviewer, Matt Stephens.

In this episode, Matt discusses the impact of Tadej Pogačar’s crash on the rest of the season and what his absence means to the peloton; the ever-present and ever-growing importance of rider safety; what the future of women’s cycling might look like if the Monuments align; who might go where, and why, and what that means for team strategies in 2027, plus he talks us through his own cycling journey from pro rider to commentator to art lover.

Chat begins at 2:54.
